jpGuide1: 用心棒ジェフリーと戦闘がある。
enGuide: Story progression. Continue directly from “【任意】白い家前：期限付きギルド仕事”. Cross Salba Desert and win the mandatory Jeffrey battle. On the second desert map, the lower-right route also leads past a Viper Fang chest if you want it.

simpleJp: 帰らずの森を出口まで抜ける
enGuide: After Salba Desert, continue through Returnless Forest only to reach White House. Do not engage Balzac on this pass: the guide is preserving the later Grovis/Fate option, and encountering Balzac first would change that reward path.

simpleJp: 白い家下水道のスイッチを押す
jpGuide1: スイッチで扉を開いて進む。
enGuide: Open the sewer doors with the local switches. The ladder surrounded by water is reached during battle by jumping across; use it to continue into White House.

simpleJp: 白い家でガルムヘッドを倒す
enGuide: Inside White House, continue until the Garm Head battle and attack the central body; destroying that core ends the fight. This is mandatory story progression, not an optional cleanup encounter.

simpleJp: ミリル救出後の次の部屋へ入る
jpGuide1: その後エルクとボスで一騎討ちになる。
enGuide: After rescuing Miril, entering the next room starts another battle. Then Elk fights the boss alone; ranged spear attacks or Charge help avoid dangerous counterattacks.

simpleJp: シルバーノア作戦室でエルクに2回話す
jpGuide1: エルクに２回話し掛けると進む
jpGuide2: エルクに2回話しかけた後チョピンに話しかけるとイベント進行
enGuide: Speak to Elk twice in the operations room, then go to the other room and speak to Chopin. That conversation starts the split-party arc. Next: “【任意・コンバート】白い家後：アーク対アンデル”.
